fields.desc:
Fabric mod id: a lower-case letter, then 1 to 63 of `a-z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-`
(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,63}$`; mcdoc checks the length, the plugin validator the pattern).
Mod version, preferably semantic (`1.0.0`).
Display name.
One-line description.
Author names.
Licence identifier, such as `MIT`; written as Fabric's `license`.
What the action does.

values.desc: Runs a data pack function at the event position.
Spawns particles at the block centre or the player's position.
Places a block state relative to the event block.
Gives the player an item; does nothing without a player.
Plays a sound at the event position.
Runs another event of the same definition.
Triggers a GeckoLib animation on the event's entity (entity definitions only; ADR 0028 D4).
